name: Soeda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Soeda town emblem in yellow and green: a yellow outlined ring of concentric lines with a cross, above a green wreath.
history: Municipal flag of Soeda, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 January 1920.

features.role: Soeda town emblem — a yellow outlined ring of concentric lines with a cross, above a green wreath
